summary: Brookfield Infrastructure Corp filed a Form 6-K containing its interim report for Q1 2026, which includes unaudited financial statements and MD&A. The filing discloses the company's ownership of a U.K. regulated distribution operation, a Brazilian regulated gas transmission operation, and a global intermodal logistics operation. There is no announcement of any transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or management change. The filing is a routine periodic report under Rule 13a-16, with no special-situation event.
